title: bn254-gt-dlp: gated segmented distinguished-point Pollard rho, expected work 2^126.888233004

claims.statement: For the full protected bn254-gt-dlp target (BN254 GT of prime order r, fixed generator g=e(P0,Q0)), the algorithm of proof.md returns x with g^x=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 2^126.888233004 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under the disclosed heuristics H1-H4. The walk is the standard 32-adding rho walk on GT with one dense Fp12 multiplication per step, a bounded distinguished-point table of 12,700 entries (1,034,432 bytes peak, < 2^20) and a fresh-coin run gate: the run opens with probability p_open=0.39/0.68=0.5735294, a closed run costs 1 unit and does no group arithmetic, and an opened run executes T=ceil(1.6*floor(sqrt(r)))=236714811010862895392714499903555895296 steps at 23,196 instruction equivalents each, giving W_run=2^127.690294 units. Expected work is p_open*W_run+(1-p_open)*1 = 2^126.888233004 and overall success is p_open*0.68=0.39. In an opened run the success probability at T is charged 0.68 against the random-map value 1-exp(-1.28)=0.721963; the identical walk, bookkeeping and recovery measured on prime-order toy groups of size about 2^27 and 2^33 return success fractions 0.675 and 0.725 at u=1.6, supporting the charge at their actual size only. All preprocessing (the 32 multipliers g^{c_j}z^{d_j}), all segments, all failures, the distinguished-point bookkeeping, the inversion mod r, the verification g^x=z and the output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortised over future targets and no advice is assumed. The per-step 22,996 is the benchmark's own reference-measured dense Fp12 multiplication (blst_fp12_mul), applied conservatively to the smaller BN254 field; the shipped portable C kernel of the same tower measures 52,313 and would give 2^128.067, which is stated and not claimed. The identity target is answered as x=0. This is a generic square-root attack: it does not reproduce or approach the published STNFS line near 2^88.4 on this track, and no optimality is asserted.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the profile and field checks, the tower/w-basis cross-check, the real-GT walk invariant, the toy collision-time campaign and the complete cost ledger. Toy runs are evidence at their size only; no production DLP, no proof of the collision-time heuristic and no verifier acceptance is claimed.
